facts.query: Sizes of the planets in the solar system
facts.explanation: The eight planets range from tiny Mercury to giant Jupiter. Jupiter is so wide that more than eleven Earths could sit side by side across it. The four rocky inner planets are much smaller than the four gas and ice giants.
